description: Deterministic mapping from host execution limits (LIM-*) to the designated semcod/* and wellmanifest/* remediation tools during planfile task execution.

bindings.name: storage-exhaustion
bindings.threshold: < 10 GB available or ENOSPC write failure
bindings.description: Resolves disk space exhaustion by scanning and cleaning stale build artifacts, large docker layers, IDE caches, and orphaned logs without disrupting active IDE sessions or primary git checkouts.
bindings.evidenceRequired: df -h / output showing recovered storage capacity >= 10 GB

bindings.name: test-bloat-and-slow-verification
bindings.threshold: Suite run time > 5 minutes or test count > 1000
bindings.command: testless scan -s <package> <targeted_tests> && testless duplicates && testless doctor
bindings.description: Eliminates duplicate, dead, and zero-unique-coverage tests. Generates LLM-ready planfiles (DEAD-*.yml) to prune redundant tests and shifts verification from monolithic runs to targeted subsystem scans.
bindings.evidenceRequired: testless planfiles generated or targeted test suite passing within budget

bindings.name: merge-pipeline-or-reviewer-lock
bindings.threshold: PR open with all checks green but blocked on external reviews or WIP concurrency limit
bindings.command: gh pr merge --admin --squash || python -m wellmanifest.merge auto-merge
bindings.description: Applies the Wellmanifest Test-Driven Auto-Merge standard (wellmanifest/merge@ticket-008). Green automated verification is the primary technical truth; waives WIP limits and bypasses self-review blocks.
bindings.evidenceRequired: All required CI checks passing (exit code 0), PR merged into main

bindings.name: dirty-primary-or-worktree-collision
bindings.threshold: Primary checkout git status not clean or concurrent branch collision
bindings.description: Enforces Wellmanifest Worktrees v5. Prohibits editing or committing on main or a dirty primary checkout. Allocates an isolated delivery worktree under <primary>/.worktrees/ticket-NNN--description with relative paths.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Active lease in .subactor/leases/ and isolated worktree directory verified

bindings.name: dependency-drift-or-venv-mismatch
bindings.threshold: ModuleNotFoundError, missing plugin, or virtualenv path mismatch
bindings.command: pactfix reconcile --lockfile uv.lock || uv pip sync
bindings.description: Reconciles broken virtual environments, synchronizes lockfiles, and ensures the host executes commands using the repo-specific .venv/bin/python rather than ambient global python.

bindings.name: resource-starvation-and-zombie-processes
bindings.threshold: Load average > CPU cores or available RAM < 500 MB
bindings.command: python -m hostguard classify && fixos "zlap bledy w systemie"
bindings.description: Classifies host resource threats and orphaned background daemons. Terminates detached zombie test runners while strictly preserving user-facing IDE windows and active worktrees.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Load average normalized, free memory restored

bindings.name: context-window-overflow
bindings.threshold: Prompt length > 80% context window or truncated transcript alert
bindings.description: Distills source code into compact AST symbol outlines and delegates sub-tasks to dedicated subagents, preventing context saturation during large refactorings.

bindings.name: flaky-test-regression-cycle
bindings.threshold: Test fails non-deterministically without code changes across consecutive runs
bindings.description: Detects non-deterministic test timing, isolates environmental flakiness, and quarantines unstable tests into dedicated bug tickets without stalling sprint delivery.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Deterministic pass or quarantine receipt recorded

bindings.name: governance-gate-rejection
bindings.description: Aligns ticket scope, component ownership, and intent.json with repository policies before code modifications are committed.

bindings.name: api-quota-and-cost-exhaustion
bindings.threshold: HTTP 429 rate limit, quota exhaustion, or sprint budget cap reached
bindings.command: costs report --sprint current && swop rotate-provider --fallback openrouter
bindings.description: Tracks per-task LLM expenses and automatically fails over across 12 supported providers when encountering rate limits or quota depletion.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Active provider healthy and cost recorded within sprint allowance
